title: Design prototype and validate a physical product
summary: Before committing a physical product design to tooling, production or customer release. A versioned design and prototype evidence pack with reviewed acceptance criteria and an explicit production decision.
outcomes: A versioned design and prototype evidence pack with reviewed acceptance criteria and an explicit production decision.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: Before committing a physical product design to tooling, production or customer release.

parts.title: Frame the user need and operating constraints
parts.guidance: Collect evidence of the user problem, intended environment, target cost and product claims. Identify uncertain assumptions and the people who can validate them.

execution.rationale: Prepare and reconcile local evidence; external action is separately approved.

parts.title: Define engineering safety and regulatory criteria
parts.guidance: Qualified engineering and specialist owners select relevant performance, safety and market-access criteria. Record required testing and stop conditions before exposing people to prototype risks.

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

approval.scope: Define engineering safety and regulatory criteria

parts.title: Prepare design alternatives and a test plan
parts.guidance: Document candidate designs, materials and expected failure modes. Specify measurable experiments and evidence needed to select a design without presenting a concept model as verified hardware.

execution.rationale: Prepare and reconcile local evidence; external action is separately approved.

parts.title: Build and test controlled prototypes
parts.guidance: Authorized competent personnel build and test prototypes using suitable facilities and protective controls. Record configuration, measurements and failures; stop unsafe trials and investigate before continuing.

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

parts.title: Review evidence and resolve design risks
parts.guidance: Engineering owners compare results with acceptance criteria and customer observations. Assign remediation and repeat testing when changes affect the safety or performance evidence.

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

approval.scope: Review evidence and resolve design risks

parts.title: Approve the design transfer decision
parts.guidance: The accountable owner approves revision-controlled drawings, requirements and remaining conditions for manufacturing. Keep required certification and production qualification as separate gates rather than claiming prototype success authorizes sale.

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

verify.how: A versioned design and prototype evidence pack with reviewed acceptance criteria and an explicit production decision.

notes.text: Operational draft. Source checked on 2026-10-30. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance, certification or completed execution is claimed. The source context is design methodology. Resolve applicable law and expert review before external action.
